messages.subject: For Ong Kim Pong | Ports, government relations and country partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Liang,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ong Kim Pong, Group Chief Executive Officer.

PSA International's global terminal network requires disciplined coordination across governments, port authorities, communities, customers and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex regulated environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, corporate affairs, country partnerships and stakeholder execution might support PSA's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to PSA International.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
